digest.component_or_area: external live test suite for Jira Cloud S3 reconciliation
propositions: A live read-only test suite must be added to validate S3-backed multi-project reconciliation against real Jira Cloud projects REB and DIG, exercising inbound fetch and dry-run preview paths only.
The suite must enforce read-only invariants structurally by monkeypatching all 18 mutating AcliClient methods (create_issue, update_issue, add_comment, etc.) to raise on invocation.
Per-project Jira issue counts must remain identical before and after each test, and unknown mapped project keys must fail-closed (raise) rather than silently succeed.
The isolated S3 store backend must use only a throwaway s3:// prefix with git-remote-s3, never reaching production, and must be cleaned up after each test run.
The suite must be gated behind REBAR_RUN_EXTERNAL and AWS credentials, wired into CI as a dedicated jira-cloud-s3-rehearsal job, and excluded from the general external job to avoid double-collection.
